name: routing_v8
instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about?

criteria.card_order_physical: Wants to get or order a physical card, or asks how/where to order a card
criteria.card_delivery: Card has not arrived yet, delivery time, tracking or delivery options for a card
criteria.card_activation: How to activate a newly received card
criteria.card_linking: Adding or linking a card to the app, including a card that was found again after being reported lost
criteria.card_expiry: Card is expiring or expired and the customer wants a replacement
criteria.card_spare: Getting an additional or second card, cards for family members
criteria.card_virtual: Getting a virtual card, what virtual cards are, virtual card not arrived
criteria.card_disposable: Disposable (single-use) virtual cards: how to get them, how many, how many uses, limits
criteria.card_virtual_not_working: A virtual or disposable card does not work or is rejected
criteria.card_brand: Card networks: whether the bank issues or supports Visa, Mastercard or other card brands, which brand the customer will get, or whether the customer can use a given card brand with the service (when topping up is not mentioned)
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used or is accepted, which ATMs or merchants take it, card spending limits
criteria.card_not_working: The physical card has stopped working or is declined when paying in a shop or online
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or retained the customer's card
criteria.pin_get: Where to find the PIN or how the PIN is received for a new card, PIN not received yet
criteria.pin_change: Setting or changing the card PIN, or where it can be changed
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN is blocked or rejected after wrong attempts
criteria.card_lost_stolen: The customer's card is lost or stolen, or they want to report or freeze it
criteria.card_compromised: The customer believes their card or account details were compromised or used by someone else
criteria.card_payment_unrecognised: A payment to a merchant, or a charge or debit transaction of an ordinary purchase amount, that the customer does not recognise, cannot identify, or says they did not make or approve
criteria.cash_withdrawal_unrecognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make
criteria.phone_lost: The customer lost their phone or it was stolen
criteria.passcode: Forgotten app passcode, resetting it, or cannot log in to the app
criteria.unknown_money_in: Money appeared in the account that the customer did not expect
criteria.refund_request: Wants a refund for a purchase, or how refunds work, or wants to cancel an order or purchase of goods or services from a merchant (including goods that never arrived)
criteria.refund_not_showing: An expected refund has not appeared in the account
criteria.charged_twice: Charged twice or multiple times for the same purchase
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: ATM gave less cash than requested or the cash amount is wrong
criteria.direct_debit_unrecognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or wants to dispute
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned unexpectedly
criteria.transfer_failed: A bank transfer failed or was declined, or the customer cannot make a transfer
criteria.transfer_pending: A transfer is pending, or how long transfers take
criteria.transfer_not_received: A transfer the customer sent has not reached the recipient
criteria.transfer_in: How to transfer money into the account from elsewhere, or an incoming transfer that has not shown in the balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot send money to a particular beneficiary or payee
criteria.transfer_cancel: Wants to cancel or correct a bank transfer already sent, including money sent to the wrong account; not cancelling an order with a merchant
criteria.deposit_not_showing: A cheque or cash deposit has not shown up in the balance
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal still shows as pending
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: Could not withdraw cash at an ATM, withdrawal declined
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, or receiving salary or incoming payments, including which currency a salary or incoming payment can arrive in
criteria.topup_how: How to top up the account, top-up methods (bank transfer, card, cash, cheque, Apple Pay, Google Pay)
criteria.topup_problem: A top-up failed, is pending, was reverted, or the money did not arrive
criteria.topup_verify: Verification code or check required for a top-up
criteria.topup_card_support: Which cards or card brands can be used to top up or add money to the account (only when the message is about topping up or adding money)
criteria.fee_atm: A fee charged for cash withdrawal at an ATM
criteria.fee_card_payment: The customer was charged a fee for paying with the card or for making a purchase or transaction, or asks whether card payments carry a fee
criteria.fee_transfer: A fee charged for a transfer
criteria.fee_topup: A fee for topping up the account by card or bank transfer
criteria.extra_charge_statement: An extra fee or a small fixed charge (for example a single pound or dollar) on the statement or in the app that the customer did not expect and wants explained, without linking it to a particular action such as paying by card, making a transaction, withdrawing cash, transferring or exchanging; a fee the customer says came with a transaction or payment they made is a card payment fee instead
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about how exchange rates are set or what rate will apply, not a complaint about the rate on a specific transaction of theirs
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: The customer says the exchange rate applied to one of their own purchases, card payments or cash withdrawals was wrong or different from what they expected
criteria.exchange_in_app: How to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.currencies_supported: Which currencies are supported for holding, exchange or spending, including any question that asks which currencies (together with which cards) can be used; not about receiving a salary or incoming money
criteria.card_fees: Cost of ordering or receiving a physical, standard or additional card
criteria.identity_verify: How to verify identity, documents needed, why verification is needed
criteria.identity_verify_failed: Identity verification not working or cannot verify
criteria.source_of_funds: Verifying the source of funds, or the customer wants to find out where the money in their account came from
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account
criteria.edit_details: Changing personal details such as name, address or phone number
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the account
